profile.headline: Software Engineer | Product-Focused Builder | ex-Slack, Accenture, Khan Academy
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a proven background in solving complex technical problems, collaborating across teams, and building scalable web products that drive high-impact business outcomes and delight users. Skilled in working at the intersection of technical excellence and user experience, I bring a pragmatic approach to modern web development and thrive in environments where empathy and engineering meet. My expertise spans modern technologies like React, Redux, TypeScript, Node, TailwindCSS, Storybook, Jest, and Cypress.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Growth (CNN)
positions.description: Skills: TypeScript · JavaScript · Web Development · Content Management Systems (CMS)

positions.title: Fractional Startup Product & Engineering
positions.description:
-Supported founders in developing investor pitch materials and go-to-market messaging for a pre-seed stealth femtech startup, contributing to early-stage fundraising efforts.

-Deepened product thinking through hands-on contributions across technical implementation, product research, and brand storytelling.

positions.title: Karim Kharbouch Coding Fellowship Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
I facilitated a summer coding and design program for 40+ high school students focusing on HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and UI/UX design.

- Mentored high school students in foundational web development through real-time code reviews, debugging sessions, and adaptive explanations tailored to different learning styles

- Supported a positive, inclusive learning environment that centered student growth and engagement, contributing to over 90% student retention throughout the 6-week program

- Designed personalized feedback loops for student assignments, identifying common misconceptions and creating targeted resources to accelerate concept mastery

- Collaborated with lead instructor to iterate on curriculum delivery based on student progress analytics, improving engagement and comprehension rates
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Mentorship · Facilitation · Curriculum Development · Student Engagement · Communication

positions.title: Software Engineer, Fullstack
positions.description: Built and updated UI features for clinician tools, supporting online treatment for 1000s of patients with opioid use dependence.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Applications · Tailwind CSS · User Stories · Software Development · TypeScript · Unit Testing · Firebase · Application Programming Interfaces (API)

positions.title: Travel
positions.description: Took a sabbatical after Slack's acquisition by Salesforce to travel, recharge, and reconnect with family. During this time, I explored Denmark, Turkey, and the Netherlands. I also reflected on my career, stayed informed on tech trends, and returned with renewed focus and energy.  I continued deepening skills in React, Next.js and modern frontend tooling.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Frontend
positions.description:
-Responsible for building out UI features for Slack's 100+ global enterprise customers across multiple industries.

-Updated and modernized Enterprise UI, reducing technical debt and ensuring maintainable code. 

-Increased coverage of unit and end-to-end tests, improving quality & stability of Enterprise UI.

-Implemented Slack's Frontend Mentorship Program with 100+ participants, improving engineering culture 

-Worked cross-functionally with Design, Product, and  Platform Engineering teams to improve UI and build new features.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Web Applications · Cypress · User Stories · Jest · Unit Testing · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · PHP · Software as a Service (SaaS) · LESS (Stylesheet Language) · Software Development · Storybook

positions.title: Software Engineer, Frontend
positions.description:
-Built UI for an e-commerce site using Angular, Typescript, & RxJS, creating 40% time savings for user data access.

-Implemented testing for all new features using Jasmine, reducing technical debt by 30%.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Applications · User Stories · LESS (Stylesheet Language) · Software Development · TypeScript · Unit Testing · Application Programming Interfaces (API)

positions.title: Software Engineering Fellow
positions.description:
-Rebuilt tutorial tool using React & Python, allowing the support of students based on real-time test results.

-Built core UI and integration for SAT and LSAT prep products using React, connecting students to resources.

-Built text-to-speech functionality for early learner products, expanding demographic reach to pre-K users.
positions.insights: Skills: User Stories · LESS (Stylesheet Language) · Software Development · Unit Testing · Application Programming Interfaces (API)

positions.title: Software Engineer, Frontend
positions.description:
-Built UI & integration for festival web app using Angular 2, Typescript & FB SDK, supporting event marketing efforts. 

-Created app that 5% of 30k festival attendees used to earn free tickets and other prizes via community service.
positions.insights: Skills: User Stories · Software Development · TypeScript · Application Programming Interfaces (API)

positions.title: Career transition
positions.description: Completed a software engineering immersive designed to accelerate a transition into a career in tech. Gained expertise in fullstack development, with a focus on JavaScript, React, Node.js, and modern web development practices.

positions.title: Associate, Grants
positions.description: Planning, development, and creation of grant proposals and reports for a portfolio of corporate and institutional funders.

positions.title: Associate, Individual Giving
positions.description: Led prospect research strategy, and made recommendations for new funding opportunities that created thousands of dollars in new donor gifts. Designed email marketing campaigns using HTML and CSS.

positions.title: Graduate Fellow
positions.description:
One of approximately 450 Fellows selected from nearly 7,000 top graduate students and 
emerging leaders for Education Pioneers leadership program. Completed a high-impact 
project for E3: Excellent Education for Everyone and attaining leadership, networking and education 
industry professional development.

projects.title: Artisanal
projects.description:
-Web app that connects users to local, specialty businesses. 

-Used MongoDB, Express, Node, and Angular to build app's features.

-Designed the app using HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.

projects.title: Feast.ly
projects.description:
-Created a web app that aggregates recipes from across the web; allows users to discover new cuisine.

-Designed the app using HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap. 

-Collaboratively built search and display functionality using Angular, yummly.com’s API, Node.js and Express with a team of 4 engineers.
